# Suppress false positives for properties not defined in reusable workflow outputs
property ".+" is not defined in object type {}

# Suppress actionlint false positive for 'models' permission (GitHub Models API)
# actionlint 1.7.3 doesn't recognize this newer permission scope
unknown permission scope "models"

# These are style warnings for consecutive echo redirects. Grouping them would
# reduce readability in our workflow context.
SC2129:style:.+: Consider using { cmd1; cmd2; } >> file instead of individual redirects

# Suppress SC2086 info for workflow input variables in .github/workflows that are controlled/safe.
# This intentionally hides SC2086 info-level warnings in workflow files; other shell scripts remain checked.
SC2086:info:.github/workflows/.+: Double quote to prevent globbing and word splitting
